UNIT_TESTS.COMMAND: cargo run --quiet -- filters dry-run --filter dotnet-build --sample 'Build succeeded.' --format json

TRACE_ASSERTIONS.ASSERTION: filters dry-run selects a TOML filter by exact name or by command match without executing the command.
filters dry-run reads sample output from --input file, --input -, or hidden test --sample.
filters dry-run --show-input renders before/after text while preserving stage-decision output.
filters dry-run --format json reports filter name, byte counts, token estimates, reduction_pct, output, and stage decisions.
filters verify --list lists loaded filter names for discoverability.
